2609.04009.title: The Blind Spot in 2D Infants' Pose Estimation:Robust Learning from Noisy Annotations
2609.04009.paper_summary: Noisy annotations pose a significant challenge for supervised deep learning, as neural networks rely on large-scale, high-quality labeled data whose corruption can severely impair model performance. Although robustness to label noise has been extensively studied for classification tasks, it remains relatively underexplored in Pose Estimation (PE). This limitation becomes critical in clinical contexts, including neonatology, where PE of preterm infants is used to support the assessment of spontaneous motility, a key indicator of neurodevelopmental trajectories. In such settings, infants' images labeling is further hindered by visual challenges (e.g., keypoint self-occlusions, caregiver interference), making the annotation process inherently susceptible to errors. To tackle noisy annotations in PE, we introduce REliable keypoint selection via Memory of traINing Dynamics (REMIND), a clustering-based keypoint-selection strategy that exploits keypoint-wise training dynamics to identify noisy labels without assuming any prior knowledge of the noise distribution, thus enabling noise-free model training. When evaluated on the proprietary NeoPose dataset, comprising 46 videos of 46 preterm infants recorded in real clinical settings, REMIND correctly identifies noisy annotations across multiple corruption scenarios, achieving up to 93\% Area Under the Curve (AUC) with three different PE architectures used in the relevant literature. To our knowledge, this is the first study to explicitly address label noise in preterm infants' PE, paving the way for the design of trustworthy learning-based algorithms for infants'monitoring support when data quality cannot be guaranteed.
2609.04009.paper_summary_zh: 嘈雜的標註對於監督式深度學習構成了重大挑戰，因為神經網絡依賴於大規模、高質量的標記數據，而這些數據的損壞可能會嚴重影響模型性能。儘管對於分類任務，標籤噪聲的魯棒性已經得到了廣泛研究，但在姿勢估計（PE）中仍然相對未被深入探討。這一限制在臨床環境中變得至關重要，包括新生兒科，因為對早產兒的PE用於支持自發運動性的評估，而自發運動性是神經發展軌跡的關鍵指標。在這樣的環境中，嬰兒影像的標註進一步受到視覺挑戰（例如，關鍵點自遮擋、護理人員干擾）的阻礙，使得標註過程本質上容易出錯。為了解決PE中的嘈雜標註問題，我們提出了通過訓練動態記憶的可靠關鍵點選擇（REMIND），這是一種基於聚類的關鍵點選擇策略，利用關鍵點的訓練動態來識別嘈雜標籤，而不假設任何噪聲分佈的先驗知識，從而實現無噪聲的模型訓練。在對專有的NeoPose數據集進行評估時，該數據集包含46個在真實臨床環境中錄製的早產兒視頻，REMIND能夠在多種損壞場景中正確識別嘈雜標註，並在相關文獻中使用的三種不同PE架構下達到高達93%的曲線下面積（AUC）。據我們所知，這是第一項明確針對早產兒PE中的標籤噪聲的研究，為在數據質量無法保證的情況下設計可靠的基於學習的算法以支持嬰兒監測鋪平了道路。
